en-US.promotionalText: Scan any food to instantly see added sugars and sweeteners. Get personalized lower-sugar alternatives. Start making better choices today!
en-US.description:
**Know Your Sugar. Choose Better.**

SugarFlag gives you instant, AI-powered analysis of added sugars and sweeteners in any food product. Just scan a barcode or snap a photo of the nutrition label to get a clear 0-100 score with plain-English explanations.

**FEATURES**

📸 **Instant Scanning**
• Barcode (UPC) scanning for instant product lookup
• Photo scanning with AI-powered OCR for any nutrition label
• Encrypted photo processing for your privacy

🎯 **Smart Scoring**
• Clear 0-100 scores based on added sugars and sweetener quality
• Plain-English explanations, not complex nutrition jargon
• Detailed sweetener breakdown with health impact

🛒 **Personalized Recommendations**
• Weekly cart suggestions with lower-sugar alternatives
• Tailored to your dietary preferences and restrictions
• Discover healthier swaps for your favorite products

📊 **Track Your Progress**
• Complete scan history with scores and insights
• See your sugar consumption patterns over time
• Export your data anytime (GDPR compliant)

🔒 **Privacy First**
• Photos encrypted on-device before transmission (AES-GCM-256)
• Passkey authentication (WebAuthn) - no passwords to remember
• Your data, your control - delete anytime

**WHY SUGARFLAG?**

The average American consumes 77 grams of added sugar daily - nearly 3x the recommended limit. Hidden sugars lurk in "healthy" foods like yogurt, granola, and whole wheat bread. Marketing labels like "natural" and "organic" don't mean low-sugar.

SugarFlag cuts through the confusion. Our AI analyzes nutrition labels and ingredients to identify added sugars, natural sugars, and all types of sweeteners - from high fructose corn syrup to stevia. You get instant clarity on what you're really eating.

**SUBSCRIPTION PLANS**

**Free**
• 10 scans per month
• Basic product scores
• Scan history

**Premium - $2.99/month**
• Unlimited scans
• Advanced recommendations
• Weekly cart suggestions
• Data export
• Priority support

**Family - $6.99/month**
• Up to 5 users
• All Premium features
• Shared scan history
• Priority support

**PERFECT FOR:**
• Reducing sugar intake
• Managing diabetes or prediabetes
• Supporting weight loss goals
• Making informed grocery choices
• Understanding food labels
• Teaching kids about nutrition

**HOW IT WORKS**

1. **Scan:** Point your camera at a barcode or nutrition label
2. **Analyze:** Get an instant 0-100 score with detailed breakdown
3. **Swap:** Discover lower-sugar alternatives tailored to your taste

**TECHNOLOGY**

• OpenAI GPT-4 Vision for accurate OCR
• 700,000+ products from OpenFoodFacts database
• 28+ sweetener ontology with health scores
• Advanced recommendation algorithm
• Secure passkey authentication

**PRIVACY & SECURITY**

• Photos never permanently stored
• End-to-end encryption for all data
• CCPA and GDPR compliant
• No third-party data selling
• Transparent privacy practices

**SUPPORT**

Have questions? Contact us at support@sugarflag.com
Privacy concerns? Email privacy@sugarflag.com
Feature requests? We'd love to hear from you!

**COMING SOON**
• Barcode scanning directly in camera view
• Meal tracking and daily sugar goals
• Recipe analyzer
• Restaurant menu scanning
• Integration with Apple Health
• Grocery list export to Instacart/Amazon Fresh

Download SugarFlag today and take control of your sugar intake. Your healthier future starts with one scan.

reviewInformation.notes:
SugarFlag is a nutrition analysis app focused on sugar content and sweeteners.

TEST ACCOUNT CREDENTIALS:
• The app uses passkey authentication (WebAuthn)
• For testing, use the demo mode accessible from the login screen
• Tap "Demo Mode" on the login screen to access full features without authentication

TEST SCENARIOS:
1. Barcode Scanning: Enter UPC "012000161551" (Coca-Cola) for a low score example
2. Photo Scanning: Use the sample nutrition label image included in the app
3. Recommendations: View personalized lower-sugar alternatives
4. Subscription: Test IAP flow (sandbox environment)

THIRD-PARTY SERVICES:
• OpenAI GPT-4 Vision API for OCR (photos processed server-side)
• OpenFoodFacts API for product database (public API)
• Stripe for payments (PCI compliant)

API KEYS:
All API keys are configured on our backend server. No client-side keys required.

PRIVACY:
• Photos are encrypted before transmission
• Privacy policy: https://sugarflag.com/privacy
• GDPR/CCPA compliant with data export and deletion

CONTACT:
• Review contact: reviews@sugarflag.com
• Phone: +1-555-0100
